findings: overlay: error and nothing: the bar's status word is cut off ('Claud', 'Listen'), so the one label that should say what went wrong reads as a typo.

overlay: nothing, idle, paused, mute: no screen shows Shrewd offering help unasked. The Answer / Coach / Visual tabs only appear after an Ask, so help-without-asking is invisible until the user clicks Ask.
overlay: attach: the attach menu drops over the chip row and hides 'What should I say?', 'Ask them' and 'Recap' (only '…act-check' still shows), so the chips can't be reached while it is open.
overlay: error: the fix it gives is 'open a terminal and run claude login', a typed step outside the app with no button for it, which is hard to do in the middle of a call.
overlay: nothing, inactive, autostop, error: the body text starts at a deep left indent with an empty gutter on the left, so the panel looks misaligned with its own header and footer.
overlay: mute and ptt: 'Listening' appears twice, once as the Session status and again on the mic pill, so the word means two different things.
overlay: region: the selected box is as grey as the dimmed screen around it and does not frame the numbers it seems meant for, so it is hard to see what will be sent.
overlay: tray-light: the Shrewd mark in the menu header loses its tile and shows as a bare 'S', unlike tray-dark.

ask: auto (dark and light): the status line breaks. 'Answered by' is clipped to 'Answered b|y' and 'Slow down' wraps onto two lines and runs into the Ask button. This is the main Active listening screen, so the first thing you read is broken.

ask: interview and behavioral (both themes): the status label is cut to 'Looking for work · Hid', so the word 'Hidden' is never shown in full. You cannot tell at a glance that Hidden mode is on, even though that is exactly what you check before an interview.
ask: insight, voice, auto: the answer leads clearly. The big 'Say' lines read first, and the Heard quote with its avatar shows why the answer came. Hierarchy is the strongest of any app here.

ask: Labels differ between screens for the same actions. compose has 'What should I say?' chips, but insight and auto have a plain-text footer 'What to say / Ask them / Fact-check / Recap' with no button edge. solo uses 'Shorter / Draft a reply / Recap'. The same action is named and drawn two ways.
ask: working: the header swaps 'Ask / Coach / pause / stop' for 'Reading … Cancel'. The bar's controls jump while an answer streams, so a mouse aimed at Coach or pause misses.

ask: insight: the 'Files' row holds a past-Session fact ('On 12 Oct Tom asked…') plus three footnotes. The label is wrong for meeting history, and the extra rows make the panel twice as tall as the answer needs.

ask: Proactive help is weak on the Ask surface itself. compose and idle show no Insight or suggestion waiting, and unasked answers only show as an 'Auto' tag in the Answer pager ('4 of 4'). Nothing tells you an unasked answer arrived while you were looking elsewhere.

ask: Both themes: metadata text ('Sonnet 4.5 · 2.3s', 'Earlier answer', the 'Files' and 'Heard' labels) is small and low contrast, especially grey on cream in light mode. The disabled brown Send in dark compose barely shows.

live: livecoach and livevisual: the Hidden mode switch in the sidebar is on, but the Overlay bar above says "Visible mode · Listening" and offers "Hide Shrewd". The screen shows two opposite states at once, so the user can't tell whether Shrewd is in the share.

live: visualtab: the Visual tab opens empty and waits for the user to press "Draw it". Nothing in the flow shows Shrewd starting a Visual by itself while the meeting talks, so this step is less proactive than the brief promises.

live: coachtab, tip, objectives: "Coach 2/4" appears twice, as a pill in the bar and again as the active tab right under it. The Overlay also calls the list "Goals", but livecoach and coach call it "Objectives".

live: visual, visualwin, visuals: the only Visual ever shown is a four-stop timeline. No process flow or system map appears, and the empty-state icon on visualtab is a line chart that matches none of them.
live: visual: the header shows the model name "Sonnet 4.5". That is jargon to read mid-call and says nothing about the Visual.
live: tip: the highlighted tip has only "Keep" and an unlabelled countdown line. It is not clear what Keep does or what happens when the line runs out, and there is no visible way to dismiss the tip.
live: livevisual: in the live window the Visual turns into a vertical list. The Overlay, Visual window and Session page all use a horizontal timeline, so the same Visual looks different here.
live: coach and visuals: the "Transcript" button in the bottom Ask bar has an empty icon space before its label, so the text sits off-centre next to "Resume".

meetings: generating: the 'Writing Notes… About 20 seconds' spinner and the 'Notes failed for this Session' error show at the same time, so the screen says two things that can't both be true. The error banner's text also sits in the middle with a wide empty gap after the icon on the left.

meetings: notes: the floating 'Ask about this Session' bar sits on top of the Objections text and cuts it off mid-word ('Northwind pays 6% le…'). It also has a 'Transcript' button that does the same job as the Transcript tab above it.

meetings: drawer: the Transcript drawer slides over the Notes column instead of pushing it aside. Notes lines are cut off at the drawer edge ('per s', 'final by'), and the 'Follow-up email' button is half hidden.

meetings: notes: the meeting timeline on the right has tiny labels cut off with '…' ('Why is the renewal ei…', 'Can a two-year com…'). Its top two thirds are empty, so it takes a full column and tells you little.

meetings: home / search: there are two inputs that do the same thing, 'Search or ask about your Sessions' in the title bar and 'Ask anything about your Sessions' at the bottom. The Home badge says 5 while the subtitle says 2 things are open.
meetings: firstrun: the sidebar has no Sessions yet, but Home still shows the badge '5', and Hidden mode is already on before the user has heard of it.

meetings: confirm: the title says 'Delete selected transcript sections?' but the body says 'deletes the selected transcription', so one dialog calls the same thing by two names. In dark, the dimmed backdrop barely separates the dialog from the page.

meetings: notes: there are seven tabs (Notes, Transcript, Asks 5, Review, Highlights, Coach notes 3, Visuals), which is a lot to scan. 'Review' doesn't match the Retro name the product uses for how the call went.

session: retro and review: there is no Retro tab. The Retro (talk time, pace, Moments) and the Engagement/Sentiment charts both sit under the same 'Review' tab, so the Retro has no name of its own and the user cannot tell which view a click on Review will open.
session: live: the Control bar says 'Visible mode · Listening' and offers 'Hide Shrewd', yet the Hidden mode switch in the sidebar is on. The two states contradict each other on the same screen.

session: transcript, asks, review, highlights, retro: the floating 'Ask about this Session' bar sits on top of the content. On transcript it covers the 19:40 and later lines and cuts through 'Marta here…', with no fade or bottom padding.
session: asks: the table is in engineering words ('Sourced', 'Input', 'Output', 'Total' tokens, 'Brief', 'Assist'), and 'Sonnet 4.5 · 2.3s' wraps onto two lines in some rows but not others.
session: review: the band copy 'Positive from 80, Neutral from 70, Negative from 50' leaves 50–70 undefined. The orange accent bars for two minutes are not explained on the chart.

session: time spine (all session tabs): every label is cut off ('Why is the renewal ei…', 'Per-seat price down s…'), and in dark mode the spine labels and timestamps are dim grey on near-black, so they are hard to read.
session: consistency between live and session: the live tab is 'Coach 3/4' but the Session tab is 'Coach notes 3', and talk share is 61% live against 54% in the Retro for the same 23-minute call.

session: highlights: a 'Rename' text button on every Chapter header competes with the Chapter titles, and the legend's '· also on the time spine' does not match the spine, which also shows 'Coach tip' and 'Auto answer' markers that have no legend entry.
setup: live: the bar says "Visible mode · Listening" while the sidebar's Hidden mode switch on the same screen is on. The two disagree, so you can't tell whether the share can see Shrewd.
setup: live: going live opens the whole Dashboard window over the meeting. The answer sits in a narrow third column in small type, so it is slow to read at a glance mid-call.
setup: firstrun, menu vs live: the Coach count reads 2/4 on firstrun and in the menu, but 3/4 on the live page.

setup: general vs livetools: one setting appears twice under different names with its choices in opposite orders: Active listening plus Response pace (Fast / Balanced / Relaxed), and Answer by itself (Off / Relaxed / Balanced / Fast).
setup: menu: there is no Manage Modes or New Mode entry. To set up a Mode during a call you go through Open the Dashboard and then Modes, one screen more than Cluely's Modes > Manage Modes.
setup: modes: the Modes list is headed "General" (the active Mode's name) above a list of the other Modes. It reads like the Settings General page, and the screen has two New Mode buttons.
setup: firstrun: Home shows a count of 5 Sessions on a page titled "Set up your first Session". In light theme the bar preview is a dark slab that doesn't match the page.
setup: recipes: the content column is centred and narrower, while every other Library and Settings page starts at the same left edge.
